import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Compute Voronoi diagram, clip to bounding box, and get Central's cell
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Union(geom)) as box
    FROM station_points
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom, id
    FROM station_points
),
clipped_cells AS (
    SELECT v.id, ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.box) as clipped_geom
    FROM voronoi v, bbox b
)
SELECT id, ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1e6 as area_km2
FROM clipped_cells
ORDER BY id
""")
cells = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Voronoi cell areas (km²):")
print(cells)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Compute Voronoi diagram, clip to bounding box, match to stations, and get Central's cell
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Union(geom)) as box
    FROM station_points
),
voronoi_raw AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
clipped_cells AS (
    SELECT ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.box) as clipped_geom
    FROM voronoi_raw v, bbox b
),
matched_cells AS (
    SELECT c.clipped_geom, s.id as station_id,
           ST_Area(c.clipped_geom::geography) / 1e6 as area_km2
    FROM clipped_cells c
    CROSS JOIN station_points s
    WHERE ST_DWithin(c.clipped_geom, s.geom, 1000)
    ORDER BY ST_Distance(c.clipped_geom, s.geom) ASC
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_id) station_id, area_km2, clipped_geom
FROM matched_cells
ORDER BY station_id, ST_Distance(clipped_geom, geom) ASC
""")
cells = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Voronoi cell areas (km²):")
print(cells[['station_id', 'area_km2']])

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Compute Voronoi tessellation in PostGIS, clip to bounding box, and count educational institutions
query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT 
        ST_SetSRID(
            ST_MakeBox2D(
                ST_MakePoint(MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom))),
                ST_MakePoint(MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)))
            ), 4326
        ) as bounds
    FROM stations
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT 
        (d).id as station_id,
        ST_Intersection((d).geom, b.bounds) as cell_geom
    FROM (
        SELECT ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)) as cells
        FROM stations
    ) v,
    LATERAL ST_Dump(v.cells) d,
    bbox b
),
central_cell AS (
    SELECT cell_geom
    FROM voronoi
    WHERE station_id = 16
),
schools AS (
    SELECT id, name, geometry
    FROM sensitive_area
    WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN central_cell c
ON ST_Contains(c.cell_geom, ST_Centroid(s.geometry))
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
central_cell_schools = int(result['school_count'].values[0])
print(f"central_cell_schools = {central_cell_schools}")
